valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (egyptaluminum) is served under two keys, EGAL PE 9.11 and EGS3E181C010.CA PE 13.91, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 59.69 percent a year from FY2022 (2.50144e+09) to FY2025 (1.0186e+10), over 3 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: price / (equity per share), equity on FY2024
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 4.125e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: price / (revenue per share), revenue on FY2025
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 4.125e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.peRouteNote: The P/E reproduces from the market capitalisation and the FY2025 net profit, but the EPS on file is that same net profit over the same share count, so the per-share route and the cap route are one arithmetic: this agreeing flag is a reproduction check, not an independent one.
